summary: Media enrichment feature verified end-to-end. All 8 backend pytest cases pass (backfill auth 401/401, backfill success with scanned/updated, at least one YouTube feud with 11-char video_id and youtube-nocookie embed_url, at least one non-Unsplash OG image, GET /api/feuds/{id} returns media object, 410 regression, vote+snapshot regression). Frontend web preview (mobile 390x844) confirmed: on feud_d0312abf93bc the feud-media-section and feud-media-youtube testIDs are visible, iframe src starts with https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/, 'VIDEO' section title above the block, footer shows 'YouTube · BuzzItalia' and '· suggerito' badge (provenance=youtube_search). Regression: 'LA FAIDA' summary, 'FONTI' block, vote-a/vote-b buttons all present. Feud without media (feud_806bd75af7d1) correctly does NOT render feud-media-section. Archive at /archive?category=all renders publisher-specific OG images (media.badtaste.it, rollingstone.it, novella2000.it, gazzettaobjects.it, tvblog, repstatic.it) mixed with the seed Unsplash fallbacks, all with naturalWidth>0 (no broken images).
critical_code_review_comments: media_extractor.resolve_media never returns a media object with type 'image' (only falls back to image_url + media=None). The FeudMediaBlock branch handling media.type==='image' is unreachable in current backend output — harmless dead code but could be documented or removed.
Backfill endpoint scans up to `limit` feuds but the filter (missing media) may leave later feuds unprocessed if force=false; harmless but consider pagination for large collections.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ user created per pytest run (test_vote_still_populates_snapshot). No manual seed data required — DB already had feuds with YouTube media populated by scheduler.
context_for_next_testing_agent: YouTube feud in DB used for testing: feud_d0312abf93bc (media.video_id=NLojaMrZrrQ, channel=BuzzItalia, provenance=youtube_search). No-media feud: feud_806bd75af7d1. Admin token in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Backend at localhost:8001, frontend at https://cerchia-app.preview.emergentagent.com.
